verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is a web-scraping API/service, not an AI agent or orchestration platform that hosts/consumes MCP servers as tools. The evidence shows ScrapingBee itself exposes an MCP server for others to plug into their AI tools (scrapingbee-probe-4, scrapingbee-docs-27), which is the reverse of this story's axis—there's no indication ScrapingBee acts as an MCP client capable of ingesting external MCP servers.
